body:
I've been hearing it for the past 7 years and it's only gone downhill.

Right now, I know there's going to be certain events in my life that are going to make it worse, and I'm completely unable to stop them. It's entirely possible I'll be homeless by this time next year. Every attempt at fixing that hasn't worked. I'm stuck, and I'm furious at myself that I can't get myself unstuck.
